jobs.title: Graduate Engineer Trainee - Process Engineering
jobs.description:
**Location:** Vengal, Tiruvallur


**Department**: Process Engineering


**Description:**


The Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) – Process Engineering supports the process engineering team in developing, documenting and improving the blade manufacturing processes on the shop floor. The GET learns design, tooling and process validation activities under the guidance of senior process engineers and works in AutoCAD, CATIA and Microsoft Office tools.


**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Support the process team in daily shopfloor process monitoring and ensure that the defined process is followed.
* Assist in preparing and updating WI, SOP and other process documents according to the change management.
* Prepare 2D drawings and 3D models for jigs, fixtures, templates and tools under guidance.
* Work closely with the tooling team to design \& detail new tools, jigs \& fixtures and support their validation and handover to Production, Maintenance, Quality and Safety.
* Provide the required inspection templates for parts / moulds.
* Support nesting, material layout and kitting activities for the prefab and shell teams.
* Participate in new tool trials, validation and documentation, and co\-ordinate with the global tooling team.
* Collect and analyses process data (CT, manhours, waste, material consumption, power, water, 3M, etc.,) using Excel and support continuous improvement projects.
* Support material trials to reduce the cost of blades.
* Assist in conducting process audits and follow up on the corrective actions.
* Support Production teams with technical training and skill development on shop floor processes.
* Ensure that all safety and quality standards are met.
* Participate in the shopfloor daily review meetings.

**Key skills:**


* Basic knowledge of manufacturing processes and engineering drawings.
* Preparation of WI, SOP etc.,
* Trials co\-ordination, validation \& documentation.
* Good communication and shop floor co\-ordination.
* CAD \& design skills in in AutoCAD, CATIA (SolidWorks / Creo / similar tools are also acceptable).
* MS Office

**Qualification:**


* B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical / Production / Industrial / Mechatronics / Composites or a related discipline (fresher or up to 1 year of experience).

**Job Description**
-------------------


* **Electronics Design Engineer \-**


We are looking for an enthusiastic Electronics Design Engineer Intern to join our Industry 4\.0 / IoT product development team. The selected candidate will assist in the design, development, and testing of embedded electronic systems and connected devices that form the backbone of smart industrial solutions.  

**Key Responsibilities**  


Assist in the design and development of electronic circuits for Industry 4\.0 / IoT devices.  


Support PCB design, component selection, and schematic capture activities.  


Work on sensor integration, signal conditioning, and power management circuits.  


Interface with microcontrollers, communication modules (Wi\-Fi, BLE, RS485, Modbus, etc.), and peripheral devices.  


Participate in prototype assembly, testing, and debugging of hardware boards.  


Collaborate with software and firmware teams for integration and functional testing.  


Maintain documentation for design updates, testing, and component specifications.  


Explore emerging IoT hardware technologies and Industry 4\.0 applications.  

**Requirements**  

**Technical Skills Required**  


Good understanding of analog and digital circuit design fundamentals.  


Familiarity with microcontroller\-based systems (Arduino, ESP32, STM, Raspberry Pi, etc.).  


Basic knowledge of communication interfaces – UART, SPI, I²C, RS485, Modbus.  


Exposure to PCB design tools (KiCad, Altium, EasyEDA, etc.).  


Hands\-on experience using test equipment (multimeter, oscilloscope, etc.).  


Basic understanding of embedded C / Python for hardware testing (preferred).  


Preferred Knowledge (Good to Have)  


Understanding of IoT system architecture – sensors, gateways, cloud connectivity.  


Experience with industrial automation concepts or embedded product prototyping.  


Awareness of power supply design and EMI/EMC considerations.  


Familiarity with hardware debugging and prototype validation.* **Electronics Engineer \- Projects**  

**Job Description**  


Assist in electronics solutions activities under supervision.  


Work on testing, troubleshooting, and calibration of electronic assemblies and instruments.  


Support solution development projects (test setups, prototyping, documentation).  


Assist the engineering team in preparing technical reports, service logs, and documentation.  


Participate in on\-site service/project support if required.  


Research and learn about new tools, equipment, and solutions relevant to projects.  

**Requirements**  


Pursuing or completed B.E. / B.Tech in Electronics or related fields.  


Fresh graduates interested in building a career in Electronics Services / Technical Solutions.  


Basic knowledge of electronic circuits, measurement instruments, and troubleshooting.
* **Robotics Engineer \- Projects**  

**About the Role**  


We are looking for enthusiastic and innovative engineering graduates to join our Industrial Automation team as Robot Programmers (Freshers). The selected candidates will be involved in live industrial automation projects across manufacturing industries.  

**Key Responsibilities**  


Learn and assist in programming industrial robots for automation applications.
Support robot installation, commissioning, and testing activities.  


Perform robot teaching, calibration, and path optimization.  


Assist in integrating robots with PLCs, sensors, vision systems, and HMIs.  


Troubleshoot robotic and automation system issues.
Participate in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT).  


Prepare technical documentation and project reports.
Follow safety standards and project quality requirements.  


Travel to customer sites for project implementation when required. **Educational Qualification**  


B.E./B.Tech in:
* Mechatronics Engineering
* Robotics \& Automation
* Electrical \& Electronics Engineering (EEE)
* Electronics \& Communication Engineering (ECE)
* Mechanical Engineering
* Instrumentation Engineering
* **Technical Sales Engineer**

We are seeking energetic and motivated **Technical****Sales** **Engineers** to support our business growth through market research, lead generation, customer engagement, and technical sales activities. Candidates with an interest in technology, sales, marketing, and industrial solutions are encouraged to apply.  


Engineering qualification is **preferred but not mandatory**. Candidates from science, technology, business, or other relevant backgrounds with good communication skills and a willingness to learn are welcome.  

**Key Responsibilities**  

* Conduct market research to identify potential customers, industry trends, and business opportunities.
* Generate leads and support customer acquisition activities.
* Promote and market the company's products and project solutions.
* Understand customer requirements and propose suitable technical solutions.
* Prepare presentations, quotations, and proposals.
* Follow up with prospective customers and maintain business relationships.
* Coordinate with technical teams for customer demonstrations and project discussions.
* Participate in exhibitions, seminars, social media promotions, and marketing campaigns.

**Products \& Projects**  


Candidates will be involved in promoting and selling Electronic Products / Automation projects / Digital Technology Solutions (MES / Traceability) / Industry 4\.0 related products.  

**Eligibility**  

* Any Graduate / Diploma Holder / Final\-Year Student.
* Freshers and Internship applicants are welcome.
* Strong interest in sales, marketing, business development, and technology\-driven solutions.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to learn technical concepts and interact with customers.
* Basic knowledge of Electronics will be an added advantage but is not mandatory.


Eligible Branches: B.Sc (Physics), B.Sc (Chemistry), BBA, MBA (Marketing). BE (ECE / Mechanical / Electrical / Robotics \& Automation / Mechatronics / Computer Science / IT) students can also be considered, provided they are interested for Technical Sales (Field Sales). **Eligibility Criteria for all the above positions \-**  


80% and above throughout academics (10th, 12th, Diploma/UG).  


No active arrears/backlogs.  


Willingness to travel across India for project execution. **Interview Process \-**  


1st Round \- Aptitude Test, Technical Test and Language Test  


2nd Round \- HR Interview  

Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview to HO for Technical Interview. **Salary Package \-** Monthly Gross\-Rs. 30K (Annual CTC \- Around Rs. 4 LPA).  


Selected candidates should be willing to sign "Service Agreement for a period of 3 years".

jobs.title: Mechancial Engineer_Graduate Engineering Trainee
jobs.description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.


Job Summary:  

The Entry Mechanical Engineer is responsible for assisting in the design and development of processes for manufacturing chemicals and related products. This role involves working under the guidance of experienced engineers, conducting research, analyzing data, and contributing to the optimization of production processes.  

  

Responsibilities:  

  

Research and Development  

* Conduct experiments and trials to develop new chemical processes or products
* Analyze data and interpret results to make recommendations for improvement
* Collaborate with other engineers and scientists to design and implement new processes

  

Process Design and Optimization  

* Design and optimize chemical processes and equipment for maximum efficiency and productivity
* Troubleshoot and resolve any issues with current processes
* Continuously improve processes through data analysis and implementation of new technologies

  

Quality Control  

* Implement quality control measures to ensure products meet safety and regulatory standards
* Monitor and analyze production processes to identify any potential quality issues
* Develop and implement solutions to improve product quality and consistency

  

Project Management  

* Plan and manage projects related to new product development, process optimization, and quality control
* Coordinate with cross functional teams to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget
* Communicate project updates and progress to stakeholders and upper management

  

Safety and Environmental Compliance  

* Ensure compliance with all safety regulations and protocols in the Mechanical Engineering industry
* Develop and implement safety procedures for handling and disposal of hazardous materials
* Stay updated on environmental regulations and make recommendations for sustainable practices

  

High Impact Behaviors:  

* Continuous Professional Development: Professionals should be committed to lifelong learning, seeking out opportunities for self improvement, and staying abreast of industry trends and best practices.
* Collaboration and Teamwork: Effective professionals understand the value of collaboration. They work well with others, contribute to team goals, and understand that diverse perspectives can lead to better solutions.
* Results Driven Performance: High performing professionals focus on delivering results. They set high standards for their own performance and are committed to achieving objectives efficiently and effectively.

  

Qualifications:  

* A bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field or equivalent work experience that provides exposure to fundamental theories, principles, and concepts.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
* Basic knowledge of chemical process engineering and safety regulations.
* Proficiency in data analysis and simulation software.
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re\-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.
